functions.name: Path_CollectAndResolveNextStepBlockers
functions.signature: uint Path_CollectAndResolveNextStepBlockers(WC3PathPrefix * path, WC3PathVector2 * source, WC3PathVector2 * destination)
functions.comment:
Normalize next step, clear fine+ac vector, temporary self suppression, class collector then168360; true iff vector empty. 756 full class0 cardinal cases. Engine payoff30 uses native route waypoint and existing class-strip sampler to collect32 candidates before velocity-based resolution. Edict order is not retail overlapping cell-link insertion order. Engine32 restores final caller goal/stops/retries only actual peer20 assignments on admitted fine legs; other vectors await source admission/recovery. [ROUTE-02.2] ROUTE-02.2 (append): candidate order = class strip cell order (row/column/rect helpers) x stored lazy-chain order per cell; per-cell stamps only, so one object can occupy several slots; null tokens for terrain/out-of-bounds/non-mover payloads; append admission stops at 32 (table capacity 32, growth 0). Only path+a0 self +40 is suppressed; path+a4 target and fine+a8 are not exempt, and objects with +40 flags 20000000/40000000 are collected. 6f168360 sees only the first 32 tokens: a faster peer at token 32 never makes the requester wait; slower peers before it still receive delay 20. Oracle verify_route02_2_blockers.py, expected sha256 1433827c28e1e59c74c5cb6863aad9b09f7d78ee72bdb0738715cc96abd611f6. Payoff125: engine collector now includes target objects, matching original self-only suppression; ordered cap/peer side effects and diagonal repeated/null tokens have production regressions.
Recovered descriptive name; target Warcraft III 1.27.1.7085.

functions.name: Path_SelectVisibleFineWaypoint
functions.comment:
Start index n-1, test entries n-2 toward0 until blocked; temporary self suppression and mask setup. 1028 baseline calls plus123 supplied original fine chains across four classes; production wc3_segment_waypoint matches selected index, including unchecked next point and first rejected farther candidate. [ROUTE-02.2] ROUTE-02.2 (append): selection reads current object occupancy at call time; static closure (48 functions, no callbacks/virtual calls) and a write audit show it writes only fine+a4, fine+cc/d0 latches, grid+b4 and object+38 stamps and the self +40 counter, so occupancy cannot change between its segment samples. Changes between successive calls change the committed index (frozen sequence 0->2->0->2(d4=1)->2->0). With fine+d4=0 (reset by search setup 6f14aea1) objects with +40 flags 20000000/40000000 do not block selection but are still collected by 6f166140. Target identity is not exempt. Payoff125: engine route construction uses explicit target suppression, released before selection with suppression-dependent cell cache discarded. Four-class target and successive-occupancy regressions drive production consumers.
Recovered descriptive name; target Warcraft III 1.27.1.7085.

functions.name: DynamicTable_AppendRepeatedDword
functions.comment:
[ROUTE-02.2] ROUTE-02.2: thiscall ECX dword table (+0c data,+14 growth,+18 capacity,+1c count), stack (value*,count), RET 8, EAX 1 success/0 failure. Appends count copies of *value; count 0 returns 1. Grows through 6f1c5130 only when count+n>capacity and growth!=0. Fine-system blocker table fine+ac is built by 6f147340 with capacity 32 and growth 0; 6f1480d0/6f148ad0 test count<32 before calling, so the blocker path never resizes.
Recovered descriptive name; target Warcraft III 1.27.1.7085.

functions.name: PathFine_CollectRectBlockers
functions.comment:
[ROUTE-02.2] ROUTE-02.2: thiscall ECX fine system, stack (x0,y0,candidates,width,height), RET 0x14. Row-major: for y=y0..y0+h-1 calls PathFine_CollectRowBlockers(x0,y,candidates,width). Used by class1/2/3 step collectors for direction codes other than 1,2,3,4,6,8,9,12 (e.g. code0 same-cell step). Verified by complete 6f166140 calls.

functions.name: DynamicTable_RemoveRange
functions.comment:
[ROUTE-02.2] ROUTE-02.2: thiscall ECX dword table, stack (start,count), RET 8, EAX 0 when start>=count else 1. Clamps count to the tail, memmoves the remainder (MSVCR120 memmove import) and subtracts. 6f166140 calls (0,count) only when the blocker table is nonempty, clearing the previous next-step vector.
Recovered descriptive name; target Warcraft III 1.27.1.7085.
